description.value: Congee Noodle House has been serving refined Cantonese cuisine on East Broadway since 1998, specializing in congee, hand-pulled rice noodle rolls, and roasted meats including signature crispy roast pork and roast duck. The single-storey restaurant features jade-themed décor and an immersive dining atmosphere inspired by Chinese tea culture. Online ordering is available, making it a convenient stop for cyclists looking for a hearty Cantonese meal in the heart of Vancouver.
